atlas_review.reason: Separate source assertions, execution success and scientific admission; preserve counterexamples and open claims.
Declare finite state/parameter/domain sets, exact identity and membership; no universal-domain assumption.
Require typed source, actions, domains/codomains, addresses and units; reject ill-typed adapters.
Review finite-word carry/overflow, exact rational imports and declared floating encodings.
State operation laws, inverse/closure conditions and quantum/unitary assumptions with witnesses.
Review dependency partial order and refinement of evidence/permissions; no invented physical order.
Count finite grammar candidates, generated children and search/sample limits.
Validate dependency DAG, chart/coupler graph types and finite node/edge budgets.
Declare control-state transitions, input grammar, guards and accepted/refused execution traces.
Exact bytes, hashes, reversible codecs, measurement loss and no unsupported compression claims.
Distinguish chart-origin layout, physical coordinates, function metrics and quantum ray geometry.
Declare cover/overlap prerequisites; full N-chart topological integration is still open.
Declare domains, derivatives, integration measures and regularity before calculus transports.
State initial/boundary conditions, dynamics and solver validity; no new solver validation claimed here.
Distinguish true transforms from same-named view helpers and retain spectrum/polarization semantics.
Born distributions, finite-shot/measurement uncertainty, null and held-out evidence remain explicit.
Bound search objectives, resource budgets, parent/child control and retry policy.
Finite values, normalization, tolerances, stability, phase residuals and independent comparisons.
Composition requires typed maps and preservation/loss witnesses; labels alone imply no equivalence.
Models need dimensions, material calibration, clocks and coordinate conventions; artistic views are labeled.
Separate basis words, amplitudes, density/channels, measurement, addresses and physical hardware.
Bound dimension, tasks, bytes, recursion, time and search effort; no unsupported speedup claim.
Keep exact original measurements/metadata and model/calibration uncertainty distinct from rounding.
